__NOTOC__
<ic>Announcement of the Quartermaster’s Guerdon:<br> Quiet Step<br>Bounders<br>Hounds of Glory<br>Granite Pillar<br>Wolves of War<br>Are entitled to draw from the Imperial Guerdon following the Autumn Equinox 381YE.<br><br><i>Approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies using the legal power to authorise targets of the Imperial Guerdon granted to them by the Senate

===Date===
* Autumn 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Owners of military units who support one of the announced armies will receive a share of the Imperial Guerdon.
